style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

rankedOutcomes.desiredOutcome: A deliberately modeled chibi customer with a softly rounded head, coherent full blue-black hair, readable round spectacles, soft hands, constructed shirt and believable compact shoes. Replace the flat faceted cap, segmented fringe, box palms, token collar rectangles and thin foot bars with coherent native forms. Proportions, construction and topology may improve inside the functional envelope; existing part counts and body coordinates are not locked.
rankedOutcomes.visibleEvidence: Front silhouette and all four facings read as the same warm cartoon character; crown, fringe, side and back hair fit together without scalp wedges, floating lobes, doubled shells or a blank slab. Garments remain distinct from skin and trousers during every pose.

rankedOutcomes.desiredOutcome: Broad soft form shading that reveals cheek, hair, cloth and shoe volume. Warmth comes from palette and gentle light rather than a hard yellow side rim. Retain horizontal rotational symmetry for world sprites and no directional ground shadow.
rankedOutcomes.visibleEvidence: No one-facing highlight privilege, black lower-body bands, faceted lighting stripes, blown skin patches or dead navy areas. Required N/E/S/W frames remain comparably legible.

rankedOutcomes.desiredOutcome: Preserve the identity palette while moving toward the target warm golden skin, blue-black hair and bright blue shirt with readable navy lower garments. Keep skin natural and warm, highlights soft, blue apparel distinct from near-black hair and glasses.
rankedOutcomes.visibleEvidence: Face, pupils and round glasses remain readable at the logical 192x320 frame; shirt does not become neon cyan and skin does not become orange. Avoid muddy material merges.

rankedOutcomes.desiredOutcome: Hair, skin, cloth and shoes should feel softly finished but distinct. Useful native collar/placket/cuff/hem/sole or pocket construction should enrich the design where readable; precise target microtexture and exact decorative counts are optional.
rankedOutcomes.visibleEvidence: Rounded edges and purposeful detail survive normal game scale without stipple, glitter, noisy fine lines, glossy plastic glare or unrelated decorations. Hair lobes form a coherent style from side and back.

rankedOutcomes.desiredOutcome: The character and expression remain clear at use size, with stable limb and food contacts through all required animation frames and real temporal playback. The existing food remains explicitly exact packed 2D food.
rankedOutcomes.visibleEvidence: No clipped hands/glasses/cheeks, beard-like smile artifacts, scalp gaps, overlapping shells, texture swimming, sudden plate/body cuts, heel drift, seat penetration, missing torso/limb surfaces, fringe flicker, silhouettes outside the registered canvas or premultiplied edge halos on light/gray/dark backgrounds.

qualityCriteria.reconciliation: Accept visible criteria and actual source contract. Native body modeling/structure/detail free within functional envelope. Supersede proposed numerical ceiling with explicit per-clip envelope; accept1e-5 transforms and.005 remodeled support surface tolerance. Semantic food mapping supersedes legacy nominal.35width text. Inspect all576frames/48realclips and allfacing use-size/context.
